objective: 以ActiveContainerContext真正替换分散的active Container、parent path与ancestry mutable state

semantic_brief.summary: DesiredReality：Agent只有一个Run-local ActiveContainerContext slot拥有execution Container与active ancestor path。ClaimUnderTest：删除旧字段/stack/set后，所有正常路径语义等价且state count兑现4→3、4→2、1→1。
core_points: ExistingEvidence：Stage A已通过typed transition门；当前旧_activeContainer、parents、ancestry仍全部存在
AllowedChange：新增exact two-field immutable context并机械迁移Agent partials与open-world active chain
ForbiddenChange：old/new dual track与非execution state迁移均在正式forbidden中排除
AcceptanceEvidence：结构计数、nested child、return、sibling、cycle、cleanup与冻结回归共同证明replacement
StopCondition：需要新增mutable truth、owner、authority或无法stage-local rollback时停止上报Leader

anchors.symbol: active Container restore and switch paths

change_principles: 新增一个且仅一个Agent-owned mutable slot `_activeContainerContext`；其value structurally immutable且语义字段严格只有ActiveExecutionContainer与ActiveAncestorPath
ActiveAncestorPath使用root-to-immediate-parent顺序保存现有parent Container handle与entered-child obligation identity；authorized child entry一次append+active switch，verified return一次pop+resume
删除 `_activeContainer` 字段并迁移Agent.cs、PlanRun、SemanticRun、OpenWorld、Recovery全部读写；不得保留compatibility alias、shadow field或双写
删除RunOpenWorldAsync method-local `parents` stack与mutable `ancestry` set；semantic depth由path长度推导，ancestry membership每次由path parent identities与active execution identity推导且不得缓存
`visited`保持独立Run-local historical identity evidence；`_branchProgress`、Container CurrentObservation/IsLocalComplete、BoundaryRelation、GoalEvidence、recovery bookmarks与trace history保持原owner与语义
非recursive PlanRun/SemanticRun直接Container replacement保持known empty path；OpenWorld child/return/recovery只按既有语义维护active path，不购买route、topology、search或re-entry
所有context replacement在既有验证完成后通过单次reference assignment发生；失败、取消或验证拒绝不得留下half-pushed path或active/path不一致
Stage A transition/read projection必须改为从context派生ActiveExecutionContainer与真实ordered path identity snapshot，不暴露live Container引用
保留当前working tree全部Stage A与其他用户dirty edits，不得回退不相关DecisionRecord/observability/Runtime改动
acceptance: 源码/反射结构测试证明 `_activeContainer` 不存在、OpenWorld无method-local Stack parents与mutable ancestry set、context无belief/visited/progress/completeness/recovery/transition字段且仅一个Agent slot
before→after报告严格为semantic truth 4→3、mutable storage 4→2、owner 1→1、diagnostic handoff保持Stage A的1→0；NET_NEW_MUTABLE_TRUTH=-1
root、authorized child、nested grandchild、verified parent return、sibling continuation分别证明active execution与root-to-parent path append/pop顺序正确，return本身不选择next sibling
cycle guard从derived ancestry拒绝A→B→A且零child dispatch；visited historical duplicate guard仍独立工作，visited不进入context
cancellation、失败分类、wrong parent、failed exact continuity与recovery failure均无half-state；context active/path始终保持内部一致并可stage-local rollback
PlanRun、SemanticRun与现有Recovery读写全部使用context且正常路径terminal/action/GoalEvidence/Container completeness语义等价
Agent ContainerContext read projection展示真实ActiveExecutionContainer与ordered ancestor identities；不暴露Container handle且无path时是known empty而非unavailable
Stage A 19个tests、冻结69基线、active ancestry/nested/return/sibling/cycle/cancellation定向tests、dotnet build与C1-C15全部通过，git diff仅scope.write加既有Stage A文件
forbidden: 禁止增加第二active Container/context/path/ancestry mutable slot或保留old field/stack/set以后再删
禁止把CurrentObservedLocation、WorldBelief、visited、BranchProgress、CompletenessRef/boolean、Container observation、latest transition、recovery bookmark或history放入context
禁止增加ContainerManager、registry、NavigationGraph、edge、route API、topology、persistence、cross-session reuse或world exhaustion语义
禁止改变GoalEvidence、completeness、return eligibility、action authorization、recovery policy、FSM、Traversal或Agent strategy semantics
禁止自动recovery/re-entry/pop/complete/sibling continuation，禁止让parent observation等于subtree complete
escalation: 若任一旧state必须与context双轨才能维持行为，停止并返回BLOCKED_FOR_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW，不得暂留
若Recovery或非recursive run需要新增owner/authority/route semantics才能迁移，列出exact call path与FDP后返回Leader
若derived ancestry无法使用现有path+active identity保持cycle/visited contracts，返回BLOCKED_FOR_SPEC并给出反例
若测试失败需要改变normal-path action/control flow、completeness或GoalEvidence，停止并返回Expected/Observed/Gap/FDP/Owner
